intro: Across 54 articles published between 2026-04-12 and 2026-10-10, ZCyberNews tracked data-breach activity spanning government, healthcare, education, technology, and retail. ShinyHunters, LockBit, and Booba each appear among the top threat actors in this coverage, while CVE-2026-35273 stands out among the CVEs cited. Reporting touched North america, United states, Europe, Global, and Canada. The severity mix skews heavily toward high-severity incidents, with 41 rated high and 6 rated medium. This archive collects that reporting in one place.
